REPORT
Date July 27, 1939.

Subject Seizure of anti-Japanese books from 680 Avenue Road.

Made by Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder

Acting on the instructions of the D.C. (Special Branch), the undersigned, Clerk Fang Kuo-liang and C.D.C. 280 Li Hai-feng and with the assistance of D.S.I. Darvill, Sinza Station, visited the Wen Tuh Book Store (文德書店), 680 Avenue Road, at 9.30 a.m. July 27, 1939.

No copies of Volume 1 "The First Year," the publication covered by the instructions of D.C. (Special Branch), were found. However, 2 copies of a book "Don't Allow the Enemy to Pass," 18 copies of which formed part of the offensive literature seized at 296 Foochow Road on the afternoon of June 27, 1939, were found and removed.

In addition, 1 copy of Volume II "The First Year," which if anything gives greater offence than Volume 1, was seized.

Waung Keng-shou (汪根寿), age 27, native of Ningpo, the proprietor of the shop, was absent at the time of our visit, his assistant was warned against allowing books of the above nature to appear on his shelves.

Translation of extracts from a book entitled "The First Year"
(第一年):_

Page 145

NIGHT ATTACK ON JEU-KWAK

Asked where the members of his family had gone, an
old man reluctantly answered with a sigh, "Two of my elder
sons were killed by - - devils." He began to weep but we
tried to sooth him by saying that we would go to the front
to kill the enemy, thereby revenging their deaths. He stated
that more than 10 persons were killed by the - - devils while
in Chang Chuen Tsun village, many young women were raped some
until they died.

- - - - - - - - - -

Page 283

THE START OF MOBILE UNITS

We should recover our land. We cannot live such a
hellish life. Please think: the land, houses, and property
which were left behind for us by our forefathers thousands of
years ago have all been plundered and razed by the - - devils;
the harvests which is the result of our hard labour during the
four seasons have been stolen by the devils.

Not only this. Just reflect upon how many of our
fellow countrymen, including fathers, mothers, children, young
and old, have been massacred by the devils! Look at the life
of this (carrying in the arms the dead body of Siao Chu-tse
小珠子 and showing it to the public). We are all born of
mothers who brought us up after so much painstaking care.
Yet the devils do not regard us as human beings but massacre,
rape, and utilize us at their free will. Are we not human
beings? We are exactly the same race as the - - devils.
Then why should we suffer their imposition without resistance?
We should all know that - - devils are planning to ruin China

第145页

夜袭居郭（JEU-KWAK）

当被问及家人去向时，一位老人叹息着不情愿地回答：“我的两个大儿子被——鬼子杀害了。”他开始哭泣，但我们试图安慰他，说我们将前往前线杀敌，以此为他们报仇。他说，在张春村（Chang Chuen Tsun），有十多人被——鬼子杀害，许多年轻妇女遭到强奸，有些人直至死亡。

- - - - - - - - - -

第283页

流动部队的开始

我们应该收复我们的土地。我们不能过这种地狱般的生活。请想一想：祖先几千年前留给我们的土地、房屋和财产都已被——鬼子掠夺和夷为平地；我们四季辛勤劳动所得的收成也被鬼子偷走了。

不仅如此。再想想看，包括父母、子女、老幼在内的多少同胞被鬼子屠杀！看看这生活（怀里抱着小珠子（Siao Chu-tse）的尸体并向公众展示）。我们都是由母亲历经千辛万苦抚养长大的。然而，鬼子并不把我们当人看，而是随意屠杀、强奸和利用我们。我们难道不是人吗？我们与——鬼子完全是同一种族。那么我们为什么要毫无抵抗地忍受他们的强加？我们都应该知道，——鬼子正计划摧毁中国

Page 314

UNITE TOGETHER AND OVERTHROW - -

You all know that the - - devils are the most cruel
and barbarous beasts. They not only seize our land, and
property, but also like mad dogs bomb our factories, schools,
cultural institutes, and communication offices of cities and
towns in the rear. In our lost areas, they mercilessly
massacre our workers, farmers, students, and young fellow
countrymen and ravish our women.

Page 315

Listeners! Don't you see? (Referring to a picture
showing some 5 devil soldiers were stabbing a half naked blood
bespattered dead body of a woman.) These are the atrocities
committed by the - - devils upon our fellow countrymen after
they had invaded our territory; all this is without exaggeration.
Actually, there are more pitiful things taking place in the
occupied areas than I have depicted. For instance in the
Three Eastern Provinces, people are often machine gunned in
hundreds and thousands in a minute by the - - devils. In
Peiping, students were arrested and stripped naked. They were
fastened to fireplaces, cooled with ice blocks on the back, and
burned with fire on the chest. In Shanghai, while a proprietor
of a pork shop and his wife were removing articles from their

我们应该报复！我们不会成为——鬼子的奴隶，我们要收回房屋、花园、土地和所有财产，保护每一个中华民族的孩子。

- - - - - - - - -

第314页

团结起来推翻——

你们都知道，——鬼子是最残忍野蛮的野兽。他们不仅抢占我们的土地和财产，还像疯狗一样轰炸后方的城市城镇的工厂、学校、文化机构和通讯办事处。在我们沦陷的地区，他们无情地屠杀我们的工人、农民、学生和青年同胞，并奸淫我们的妇女。

第315页

听众们！你们没看见吗？（指着一张图片，显示大约5名鬼子士兵正在刺戳一具半裸、血迹斑斑的女尸。）这些都是——鬼子入侵我国土后对我们同胞犯下的暴行；这一切都毫无夸张。实际上，在被占领区发生的悲惨事情比我描述的还要多。例如在东北三省，人们经常成百上千地在分钟内被——鬼子用机枪扫射。在北平，学生被捕并被剥光衣服。他们被绑在火炉上，背部用冰块冷却，胸部用火焚烧。在上海，当一家猪肉店的店主和他的妻子正在从家中搬运物品时，

completely naked. They were then hanged on the pork shelves
with iron hooks which were used for hanging pigs. In Yangchow,
after the - - beast soldiers had gained the city wall, they
searched for and carried off able-bodied persons and shot all
educated men. Once while we were fighting with the devils at
Shiao Hsien in Anhwei, we destroyed a bridge, thereby isolating

The - - devils killed every Chinese they saw. With the bodies

We are all men full of blood. Can we stand idly by whilst

Further to the attached file, Ma Ling (馬翎 ),
the editor of the "Nyi Lun" ( 藝輪 ), a Chinese
semi-monthly magazine, 856 Peking Road, was interviewed
at Police headquarters during the morning of June 24,
1939, when he submitted an application to register
the magazine with the Municipal Police. Owing to
the ambiguous manner in which he answered questions
relating to the publication of the periodical, he
was informed that the magazine would not be registered.
Ma Ling was advised, however, to inform his employers
to submit an application to register at Police
headquarters two months later, when the subject would
be reconsidered.

During the morning of June 21, 1939, detectives
attached to the Special Branch visited the Wu Chow Bookstore
(五洲書局), 221 Shantung Road, and seized 26 copies of the
"Nyi Lun", an unregistered semi-monthly magazine.
The manager Poh Wu-chow ( □□ ) was questioned
regarding the names and addresses of the publisher and editor,
but denied all knowledge as to their whereabouts. The
impression gained, however, is that he is unwilling to give
the necessary information to the Police as the policy of
placing this type of literature on public sale is profitable,
insofar as his establishment is concerned. Consequently
the manager is not required to furnish particulars regarding
sales following seizures of booklets by the Police.

Nyi Lun ( 奔輪 ), a semi-monthly magazine, publishes
the following two articles in vol. 1, Issue No. 1, dated
June 20, 1939 :-

A PLAY ENTITLED "COUNTER-ATTACK"

The text of the play contains the following
expressions :-
1) Will not this increase the ambitions of the devils to
massacre youths?
2) I want to go with our comrades to deal with the devils.
3) Don't blame me, father; it is entirely due to the vicious
devils.
4) The situation becomes grave. How barbarous are the
devils.
5) The devils depend solely upon their guns and field pieces.
If hand-to-hand fighting takes place, all the devils will
be wiped out.
6) Short-lived devils! How dangerous they are to our lives!
7) Will the devils come to our places?
8) It is said that Canton was taken by the devils last night.
9) We are of the Imperial Army and we want to take a census.
Open the door quickly.
10) Some fat and short men came in, of whom the first was
a military officer of the devils.

-------

VICTORY

Several months ago, the enemy attacked a small island
called Nan nao ( 南澳 ) opposite Swatow. It is an isolated
island and the enemy can get no benefit from its possession.
The Chinese Government detailed men under the command of
Hung Ts-tseng ( 洪之政 ) to undertake the defence of the
island.

On a certain night, the enemy started to bombard
page_data.zh:
《奔轮》（Nyi Lun）半月刊在1939年6月20日出版的第一卷第一期中刊登了以下两篇文章：-

一出名为《反击》的戏剧

剧本文本包含以下表述：-
1) 这难道不会增加鬼子屠杀青年的野心吗？
2) 我想和我们的同志一起去对付鬼子。
3) 别怪我，父亲；这完全是因为邪恶的鬼子。
4) 局势变得严峻。鬼子多么野蛮。
5) 鬼子完全依赖他们的枪支和大炮。如果发生肉搏战，所有鬼子都将被消灭。
6) 短命的鬼子！他们对我们的生命多么危险！
7) 鬼子会来我们这里吗？
8) 据说广州昨晚被鬼子占领了。
9) 我们是皇军，我们要进行户口调查。快开门。
10) 进来几个又胖又矮的人，其中第一个是鬼子的军官。

-------

胜利

几个月前，敌人进攻了汕头对面一个叫南澳（Nan nao）的小岛。这是一个孤岛，敌人占有它得不到任何好处。中国政府派遣洪之政（Hung Ts-tseng）指挥的人员负责该岛的防御。

在某天晚上，敌人开始轰炸

the island. When the enemy landed on the island, machine
guns were directed at the enemy and howitzers also came
into action. The enemy launches were overturned and
their soldiers were thrown into the water.
When the enemy had withdrawn, a gallant company
commander under Hung Is-tseng was still standing alone,
his forehead bleeding, but he was already dead.
With tears in his eyes, Hung Is-tseng said :
"Commander, you have sacrificed your life for the country".
The body of the company commander then collapsed
to the ground.

Translation of extracts from a booklet entitled "Travels in
North-West" (西北旅行記 ) :-
Page 37-38

The extent of the blows felt by the people
of Chinghai Province as a result of the more intense invasions
by the Japanese can be seen from the Flower Lantern Festival.
Though there are as many persons as there were last year,
nobody is willing to buy furs and medicinal stuffs any more.
The Llamas are also planning to pray for peace. People are
much excited to hear the slogan "Down with the Japanese
Imperialism." The festival at the Te Erh Shih Temple this
year gave rise to a joint war resisting propaganda meeting
at which, speeches were delivered by the officials of the
Chinghai Provincial, Military, Political, and Tangou
authorities. Though the people of various races present at
the meeting could not understand these speeches, they, however,
personally saw the Mongolians who had fled to the place from
Suiyuan and Mongolia. The Mongolians piteously related how
the Japanese warlords massacred their fellow countrymen, stole
cattle and sheep, raped women, ..... all this is more powerful
than ordinary propaganda and can truly excite the sympathy
of the various races in Chinghai.

"Let us not fall into the traps set by the
Japanese. The Japanese devils are the evil spirits of East
Asia and public enemies of the human race. Their bayonets
have no eyes. They are a thousand times more ready to give
us bombs, heroine, and red pills than to tempt us. Rise,
rise, brothers of our various races, we should unite together!"

The speaker was a student of the Sining
Branch of the Central Political College. His speech
represents the roars of the awakened people of Chinghai.

第37-38页

从花灯节可以看出，由于日本更激烈的入侵，青海省人民所遭受打击的程度。虽然人数与去年一样多，但已无人愿意购买皮货和药材。喇嘛们也在计划祈祷和平。人们听到“打倒日本帝国主义”的口号非常激动。今年塔尔寺的节日引发了一次联合抗日宣传会议，青海省政府、军方、政治当局及唐古（Tangou，音译）当局的官员在会上发表了演讲。虽然出席会议的各族民众听不懂这些演讲，但他们亲眼看到了从绥远和蒙古逃到那里的蒙古人。蒙古人悲惨地讲述了日本军阀如何屠杀他们的同胞，偷窃牛羊，强奸妇女，..... 所有这些比普通的宣传更有力量，确实能激起青海各族人民的同情。

“让我们不要落入日本人设下的陷阱。日本鬼子是东亚的恶魔，也是人类的公敌。他们的刺刀不长眼睛。他们给我们炸弹、海洛因和红丸的准备程度，比诱惑我们要高出千倍。起来，起来，我们各族的兄弟们，我们应该团结在一起！”

演讲者是中央政治学院西宁分院的一名学生。他的演讲代表了觉醒的青海人民的怒吼。

page_data.en:
-2-

Our education in the frontier regions has brought appropriate
results but it is a pity that education has not yet reached
the ordinary masses.
Who would have thought that the blows
of the Japanese Imperialism reached the far distant Flower
Lantern Festival at Te Erh Shih Temple? Yet after the
occurence of this propaganda meeting, the words "Not to be
deceived by the Japanese" have been carried by the visitors
coming from other places to the various people in different
regions.
page_data.zh:
-2-

我们在边疆地区的教育取得了适当的成果，但遗憾的是，教育尚未普及到普通民众。
谁会想到日本帝国主义的打击会波及到遥远的塔尔寺花灯节？然而，在这次宣传会议之后，“不受日本人欺骗”的话语被来自其他地方的访客传给了不同地区的各族人民。

“在华北战事中，国民革命军第八路军（前身为中国红军）屡次击败敌军，俘获无数战俘并缴获大量战利品。该军在日军后方积极组织开展游击活动。”
“毛泽东说：‘自1931年九一八事变以来，中国革命的根本使命就是反对日本，并与日本侵略中国的行为作斗争。’”
“数千万中国人民参与了抗日战争。虽然他们在这场战争中遭受了巨大苦难，但中国人民抵抗日本侵略、争取中华民族完全独立的决心变得更加坚定。”

"The Japanese troops arrive at Chueh Tsung Village.

"I witnessed in the - - Cotton Mill a poor child

“日军抵达厥宗村。一天晚上，张夫人叫来她的儿子说：‘我们中国人不能等着日本兵来照顾我们。’”

"Well, Chao San," Kao Tang-sun ordered, "you take
your men early to-morrow morning to Tungchwang, a village
15 li away from Sinliuchwang. Use that village as a base
and make necessary preparations before launching an attack
upon Sinliuchwang, thereby capturing it and killing all the
'Wo' (an ancient name for Japan) devils and Chinese traitors.
You must allow none of them to escape."

"Yes, commander Kao," replied Chao San. Chao was
much pleased to be assigned to this important mission and
to wreak his vengeance on the enemy. He was in fine spirits
while preparing to fight the poisonous snake in its hole.

They thought that Tungchwang must have been destroyed

stories on killing and incendiarism, which might give room
for idle gossip.

Widow Ting argued, saying, "How could I be held to

soldiers, one holding my hands and another my legs, and I
could not resist them. I was raped; it was not I myself
who went to seek for men. There are many girls who have
their paramours; are they not feeling ashamed? To commit
adultery and to be raped by others are different. There's

“好吧，赵三，”高堂孙命令道，“你明天一早带人去距离辛六庄15里的东庄。以该村为基地，在进攻辛六庄之前做好必要准备，从而攻占该村，杀死所有‘倭’（日本的古称）鬼子和汉奸。绝不能让他们任何人逃脱。”

“是，高司令，”赵三回答。赵三对于被指派执行这一重要任务并向敌人复仇感到非常高兴。他在准备深入虎穴歼灭毒蛇时情绪高涨。

他们认为东庄肯定已被“倭”鬼子摧毁，那里一定有关于杀戮和纵火的刺激故事，这可能会成为闲谈的话题。

丁寡妇辩解说：“王姥姥，怎么能怪我呢？有三个像‘倭’鬼子一样的士兵，一个抓住我的手，另一个抓住我的腿，我无法反抗他们。我被强奸了；并不是我自己去找男人。很多女孩都有情夫；她们不觉得羞耻吗？通奸和被他人强奸是不同的。我没有羞耻可言。”

page_data.en:
- 2 -

"How was it she did not succeed in running away?
She said when it came to her notice, that the 'Wo' devils
had already appeared beside her. Well, how could the 'Wo'
devils know that she was in the kitchen and how could they
have located her?"

"You can't believe in what she has said," explained
Ideu Tsi-shaw." "The 'Wo' devils could not have known that
she was in the kitchen nor could have they located her.
Ting Erh-shaw tried to persuade her to take refuge at some
other place, but she wouldn't. She could not remain a
widow, that's why she herself went to seek these 'Wo' devils."
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

“她怎么没能逃跑成功呢？她说当她注意到时，‘倭’鬼子已经出现在她身边了。那么，‘倭’鬼子怎么会知道她在厨房里，又怎么会找到她的？”

“你不能相信她说的话，”刘子绍 (Ideu Tsi-shaw)（音译）解释道。“‘倭’鬼子不可能知道她在厨房里，也不可能找到她。丁二绍 (Ting Erh-shaw)（音译）曾劝她去别处避难，但她不肯。她守不住寡，这就是为什么她自己去找那些‘倭’鬼子的原因。”

page_data.en:
Translation of extracts from a book entitled Siao Lah-lee
("Little Scabby Head"·小癩痢) published by the
Library Department of the News Digest at No.117, Avenue
Edward VII :-

Page 3
Siao Lah-lee heard his brother say, "Papa,
Li San (李三) in the East Village and Wang Loh (王洛)
in the West Village have all gone to fight for the country.
If we don't go and dig trenches, it would be too late when
the Japanese soldiers invade our land! The Japanese
soldiers are furious; they are killing people by thrusting
bayonets into their abdomen ......"

Page 16
Shiang Koo-nian (香姑娘) was nearly bursting
into tears! She said: "Japanese devils! O hateful
Japanese devils. You have seized our homes and our farms,
and you have also killed my mother."
What? Your mother was killed by the Japanese
devils? Ah, what shall we do? But do not cry, Shiang
Koo-nian. Siao Lah-lee will avenge her! I will go to
Shanghai and join the fighting.

Page 17
The young man said: "I tell you that it is
the Japanese who are making you suffer from cold and
hunger and made you homeless!"
The entire group answered: "Yes, you are right.
We should overthrow the Japanese Imperialists."
"If you want to overthrow Japanese Imperialism,"
remarked the young man, holding a whip in his hand, "you
must use this weapon. Our empty hands and clenched fists
will also serve as our weapons."
page_data.zh:
译自《新闻文摘》图书馆部（位于爱多亚路117号）出版的名为《小癩痢》（Siao Lah-lee，“Little Scabby Head”）一书的摘录：

第3页
小癩痢听他哥哥说：“爸爸，东村的李三和西村的王洛都去为国参战了。如果我们不去挖战壕，等日本兵侵入我们的土地时就太晚了！日本兵很愤怒；他们正用刺刀捅进人们的腹部杀人……”

第16页
香姑娘（Shiang Koo-nian）几乎要哭出来了！她说：“日本鬼子！可恨的日本鬼子。你们抢占了我们的家园和农田，还杀了我的母亲。”
什么？你母亲是被日本鬼子杀害的？啊，我们该怎么办？但是别哭，香姑娘。小癩痢会为她报仇！我要去上海参加战斗。

第17页
那个年轻人说：“我告诉你们，正是日本人让你们受冻挨饿，让你们无家可归！”
众人齐声回答：“是的，你说得对。我们应该推翻日本帝国主义者。”
“如果你们想推翻日本帝国主义，”那个年轻人手里拿着鞭子说道，“就必须使用这个武器。我们空着的双手和紧握的拳头也可以作为我们的武器。”

page_data.en:
-2-

Page 26
"I hope," Lee Kuo-hwa (李國華) continued,
"that our little friends will unite and overthrow the
Japanese robbers.
"Little friends! When we become slaves, we
shall suffer very much. They will allow only one knife
for every seven families and when they are tired of walking,
they will order one of us to crawl down and let him sit on
our back..... Little friends, do we want to be slaves?"
They all shouted: "We do not wish to be slaves.
Those who are unwilling to be slaves should overthrow
Japanese Imperialism."

Page 61
Lee Kuo-hwa said, "Grown up persons should unite
with the youths! If the Japanese robbers attack us, we
must rise and annihilate them!"
"All right, should they come we shall at once
exterminate them," the group responded.

Page 123
Siao Lah-lee was meditating upon his mother's
death.
"If the Japanese devils really come and attack
us, what shall we do?" said his father with a sigh.
As soon as Siao Lah-lee heard the words
"Japanese devils", he at once forgot about his mother and
rose in great excitement. Let the Japanese devils come.
Why should there be any fear? What is the use of sighing?
What shall we do? Very simple: we should exterminate
them when they come.
page_data.zh:
-2-

第26页
李國華（Lee Kuo-hwa）继续说道：“我希望我们的小朋友团结起来，推翻日本强盗。
“小朋友们！当我们成为奴隶时，我们将遭受极大的痛苦。他们每七户人家只允许留一把刀，当他们走累的时候，就会命令我们中的一个人趴下，让他们坐在我们的背上……小朋友们，我们愿意做奴隶吗？”
他们都喊道：“我们不愿意做奴隶。不愿做奴隶的人应该推翻日本帝国主义。”

第61页
李國華说：“成年人应该与青年联合起来！如果日本强盗攻击我们，我们必须奋起消灭他们！”
“好吧，如果他们来，我们就立即消灭他们，”众人回应道。

第123页
小癩痢正在沉思母亲的死。
“如果日本鬼子真的来攻击我们，我们该怎么办？”他的父亲叹息道。
小癩痢一听到“日本鬼子”这几个字，立刻忘记了母亲，激动地站了起来。让日本鬼子来吧。有什么好怕的？叹气有什么用？我们该怎么办？很简单：他们来了就消灭他们。

page_data.en:
-6--

Face 124
After a while, Siao Lah-lee fell asleep and had
the following dream :-
Ah-ya! The Japanese devils have really come to
attack! Ha-ha, the Japanese devils are so short that they
make others laugh to death. Wei-wei, Japanese devils,
don't fear me Siao Lah-lee but come along with me and see
who is the taller.
Ha-ha! a Japanese devil is coming, carrying a
gun three times his height. He stands by the side of Siao
Lah-lee. Ha-ha! his tortoise head reaches only Siao
Lah-lee's shoulders.
Ha-ha-ha-ha! how can such a short and little
thing fight China? Heaven only knows.
page_data.zh:
-6--

第124页
过了一会儿，小癩痢睡着了，做了如下一个梦：
哎呀！日本鬼子真的来进攻了！哈哈，日本鬼子矮得让人笑死。喂喂，日本鬼子，不要怕我小癩痢，跟我来比比谁更高。
哈哈！一个日本鬼子走了过来，扛着一支比他身高长三倍的枪。他站在小癩痢身边。哈哈！他的乌龟头只到小癩痢的肩膀。
哈哈哈哈！这么矮小的东西怎么能和中国打仗？只有天知道。

Translation of extracts from a booklet entitled "A Day That Shall
Never Be Forgotten" (永不忘卻的一天)

Pages 1 to 3

SONG OF LIFE

We are a group of children from guerrilla districts,
We have lost our parents.
Our homesteads
Have been burnt to the ground by the foreign tribes.
Our friends
have been driven away and rendered homeless by the foreign
tribes at the point of bayonets.
We are left alone
Wandering in a strange land.
Beacon fires flaming all over the country
Warm-blooded youths are serving their nation in the battlefield.
Men who have lost their conscience,
In order to enjoy a momentary life of pleasure
They advocate compromise and surrender
Forgetting the blood shed by their fellow countrymen.
We are the descendants of Emperor Huang Ti,
Why should we tolerate oppression and insult from others
How could we remain unmoved when our nation is facing
dismemberment and ruin?
Rise up, men of the same fate,
Let us sound the clarion to awaken our fellow-countrymen
from their dreams.

Pages 94 to 100

The street was deserted. I advanced a few paces and I
saw two soldiers wearing khaki uniform pointing rifles at me.
I realized that the foreign troops had entered our village. I
stood motionless and one of the soldiers searched my body and
as he did not find anything he told me to go.
page_data.zh:
译自小册子《永不忘卻的一天》（A Day That Shall Never Be Forgotten）的摘录

第1至3页

生命之歌

我们是一群来自游击区的儿童，
我们失去了父母。
我们的家园
已被异族烧成平地。
我们的朋友
被异族在刺刀的逼迫下赶走，变得无家可归。
我们孤零零地
流浪在陌生的土地上。
烽火遍布全国
热血青年在战场上为国效力。
那些丧失良心的人，
为了享受片刻的享乐生活
他们鼓吹妥协与投降
忘记了同胞流下的鲜血。
我们是黄帝子孙，
怎能容忍他人的压迫和侮辱
当国家面临分裂和毁灭时，我们怎能无动于衷？
起来，命运相同的人们，
让我们吹响号角，唤醒同胞们的梦想。

第94至100页

街道上空无一人。我向前走了几步，看见两名身穿卡其色制服的士兵用步枪指着我。我意识到外国军队已经进入了我们的村庄。我站着不动，其中一名士兵搜查了我的身体，由于没发现什么东西，他让我离开。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Suddenly I heard foot steps and I saw a party of about 10 devil soldiers led by a Chinese holding a rising sun flag. The man was speaking to the leader of the party of devils. I recognized the man who was arrested the other day on charge of being a -- traitor (because he had been signalling when foreign aeroplanes flew over our village). When he saw me, he whispered some words to the captain of the devils and at the command of the latter 5 devils approached me and dragged me away. I tried to break away, but I was given two blows. My hands were tied behind my back and I had to follow the devils. As I was tired out, I slowed down my pace but instantly a whip fell on my body. Oh! The pain I had suffered. Had I been in possession of a pistol, I would not have rested until I had shot that enemy devil.

On arriving at the Police Bureau, I was pushed into the entrance by the devil. There was a wooden board with inscriptions "Dai XX Gendarmerie --". Several devils dragged me into a small and dark house which was already filled up with fellow-countrymen suffering the same fate.

We were later taken to a bigger room. At the table sat an interpreter of the devil soldiers. He was a notorious loafer in the village and somehow he managed to learn their language and now he was willing to betray his conscience and his Fatherland to become a -- traitor. By his side there sat the captain of the so-called XX gendarmes.

The first one of us to be tried was a workman. The interpreter asked his name to which he replied, "You are trying to ask me? Never mind about my name but at any rate I am better than you shameless running dog of the foreigners." The workman then spat at the interpreter and it happened that some of the saliva struck the eye of the captain of the gendarmes. The latter instantly shouted and three devil soldiers came forward, pushed the workman to the ground and stabbed him with bayonets. The sound made by the contact of the bayonets with the bone, the cries

- 2 -

突然我听到脚步声，看见一队约10名鬼子兵，由一名手持旭日旗的中国人带领。那人正在同鬼子队的头目说话。我认出这个人前几天因被指控为——汉奸（因为当外国飞机飞越我们村庄时他在发信号）而被捕。当他看到我时，他对鬼子队长低声说了几句话，随后在后者的命令下，5名鬼子向我走来并将我拖走。我试图挣脱，但挨了两下打。我的双手被绑在背后，不得不跟着鬼子走。因为我筋疲力尽，放慢了脚步，但瞬间鞭子落在我身上。哦！我所遭受的痛苦。如果我有一把手枪，我不射杀那个敌人鬼子决不罢休。

到达警察局后，我被鬼子推进入口。那里有一块木板，上面写着“大XX宪兵队——”。几名鬼子将我拖进一间又小又黑的屋子，里面已经挤满了遭遇同样命运的同胞。

后来我们被带到一个更大的房间。桌旁坐着一名鬼子兵的翻译。他是村里一个臭名昭著的懒汉，不知怎么学会了他们的语言，现在他愿意背叛良心和祖国，成为一名——汉奸。他旁边坐着所谓的XX宪兵队队长。

第一个受审的是一名工人。翻译问他的名字，他回答说：“你想问我吗？别提我的名字，反正我比你这个无耻的外国走狗强。”工人随即朝翻译吐了一口唾沫，碰巧有些唾沫溅到了宪兵队长的眼睛里。后者立刻大喊，三名鬼子兵上前，将工人推倒在地，并用刺刀刺他。刺刀接触骨头发出的声音、工人的惨叫

- 5 -
of pain uttered by the workman and the laughs of the captain of
the gendarmes mingled together. The blood flowed all over the
place and the dying workman was later removed by two devil
soldiers.
The next one to be examined was my old teacher
Chow. He stood nonchalantly before the interpreter.
The interpreter asked in a fierce manner: "Speak
out at once that you are the leader of the anti-XX work in this
locality."
"Yes, I am."
"Then disclose the names of your confederates,
otherwise beware of yourself!"
"Good. I say that all the Chinese people are
patriotic and that everyone of them is anxious to save the
country. Only you, a dirty and shameless rascal, is willing to
betray your fatherland and work as a -- traitor against your
own conscience!"
"Stop talking nonsense. Beware of your dog life!"
"Hum! Do I fear death? If so, I would not have
engaged in the national salvation activities!"
The interpreter felt abashed. He spoke a few words
to the captain of the gendarmes whereupon my old teacher was
taken away by six devil soldiers.
My turn came and when I was being examined, I heard
the shout outside the window, "Long live the Republic of China!"
The shout came from my old teacher. Immediately after several
sounds of "Pang, Pang" reached me and I closed my eyes and dared
not think any longer.
Now I have made up my mind: I must follow the steps
of the martyrs to resist the brutal foreigners. I shall never
forget the day when my old teacher sacrificed his life and I shall
avenge the death of my old teacher and those of the martyrs who
had been killed by the foreigners.

- 5 -
声以及宪兵队长的笑声混杂在一起。血流得到处都是，垂死的工人后来被两名鬼子兵抬走。
下一个受审的是我的老教师周先生。他漫不经心地站在翻译面前。
翻译凶狠地问道：“马上承认你是本地反XX工作的领导人。”
“是的，我是。”
“那就供出你的同伙名字，否则小心你自己！”
“好。我说所有中国人都爱国，每个人都急于救国。只有你这个肮脏无耻的流氓，才愿意背叛祖国，违背良心充当——汉奸！”
“别胡说八道。小心你的狗命！”
“哼！我怕死吗？如果怕，我就不会从事救国活动了！”
翻译感到羞愧。他对宪兵队长说了几句话，随后我的老教师被六名鬼子兵带走。
轮到我了，在接受审讯时，我听到窗外传来喊声：“中华民国万岁！”
喊声来自我的老教师。紧接着传来几声“砰、砰”，我闭上眼睛，不敢再想下去。
现在我已下定决心：我必须追随烈士的脚步，抵抗残暴的外国人。我永远不会忘记老教师牺牲的那一天，我将为老教师以及被外国人杀害的烈士们报仇。

Boy Scouts' War Time Service Pictorial (中國童子軍戰時服務畫刊),
Issue 1, dated December 20, 1937 :-

ACTIVITIES OF BOY SCOUTS IN WAR TIME

The gunfire of the invaders is to be seen every-
where, while the flames of the war of resistance is being
extinguished everywhere.

For the sake of their existence, the people are
universally advocating a war of resistance.

The boy scouts organization is a peaceful body.
Every boy scout desires peace. However, in the face of
the atrocities committed by the peace-breakers the boy
scouts cannot remain calm. The boy scouts hate war, but
for the sake of world peace, they are willing to take part
in battles. Thus it was that the boy scouts of Shanghai
proceeded to the front during the January 28 Incident.

In an open letter to the scouts of the world,
the Shanghai Boy Scouts' War Time Service Corps calls upon
the people of the world to rise and destroy the enemy of
boy scouts.

For three months, the boy scouts did noble work on
the battlefield, but they are still dissatisfied. Recently,
the boy scouts of Shanghai left for the interior. They
have only one mind : that of determination to render
service so long as the war of resistance continues.

The gallant deeds of the Shanghai boy scouts will
permanently remain fresh in the minds of the people. They
work bravely, caring nothing for their homes or their
bodies. Before long the 500,000 boy scouts throughout
the country will walk to the battlefield of the war of
resistance.

《中國童子軍戰時服務畫刊》，
第一期，日期為1937年12月20日：-

戰時童子軍之活動

侵略者之槍聲處處可見，而抗戰之烽火亦處處熄滅。

為求生存計，民眾普遍倡導抗戰。

童子軍組織乃一和平團體。每名童子軍皆渴望和平。然而，面對破壞和平者所犯之暴行，童子軍無法保持冷靜。童子軍憎惡戰爭，但為世界和平計，彼等願意參戰。因此，上海童子軍在「一·二八」事變期間奔赴前線。

上海童子軍戰時服務團在致全世界童子軍的公開信中，呼籲世界人民起而摧毀童子軍之敵人。

三個月來，童子軍在戰場上做出了高尚的工作，但他們仍感不滿。近期，上海童子軍已前往內地。他們只有一個念頭：只要抗戰繼續，便決心提供服務。

上海童子軍的英勇事蹟將永遠鮮活地留在人們心中。他們勇敢工作，不顧家室與自身安危。不久之後，全國五十萬童子軍將走向抗戰戰場。

Extracts from a book entitled "Articles on Collective
Life" (論集體生活) :-

Page 20
Owing to sympathy with the Fascist nations and
envy of the Soviet, Mr. Neville Chamberlain adopted an
arbitrary and realistic policy that has given way to the
aggressive nations. Matters came to climax in 1938.
He forced Mr. Eden who favoured a collective security to
go away. He was the creator of the Munich Pact; he
sacrificed Spain; he put a lawful label upon Mussolini's
stolen property in East Africa, Austria is finished and
Czechoslovakia has been sold through a trap laid by Mr.
Chamberlain in Munich. The sad drama of China has paved
an aggressive way for Hitler and has placed France in a
solitary position.

Page 63
On the outbreak of hostilities, Italy rendered
assistance to the Japanese as follows:-
1. At the beginning, the Japanese had great
difficulty to obtain provisions after being pushed by
the Chinese troops into a corner of the Settlement. The
Italians secretly helped the Japanese by collecting large
quantities of food from the various bakeries.
2. After the outbreak of hostilities, Italy,
under the pretext of protecting the Italians, sent batches
of Italian troops to Shanghai in September, 1937. According
to reliable figures, the ratio of Italian citizens to
Italian soldiers in Shanghai was one to seven. The
upkeep of these troops was paid for by the Japanese; at
the same time the Italians promised to let the Japanese
pass through their sector in the Western District to
attack the Chinese troops.

題為《論集體生活》（ Articles on Collective Life ）一書之摘錄：-

第20頁
出於對法西斯國家的同情和對蘇聯的嫉妒，內維爾·張伯倫先生採取了一種武斷且現實的政策，從而讓步於侵略國家。事態在1938年達到高潮。他迫使主張集體安全的艾登先生離去。他是《慕尼黑協定》的製造者；他犧牲了西班牙；他為墨索里尼在東非的贓物貼上了合法的標籤；奧地利完蛋了，而捷克斯洛伐克則通過張伯倫先生在慕尼黑設下的陷阱被出賣。中國的悲劇為希特勒鋪平了侵略之路，並使法國陷入孤立無援的境地。

第63頁
戰事爆發後，意大利向日本提供了如下援助：-
1. 起初，日軍被中國軍隊逼至租界一角後，在獲取給養方面面臨巨大困難。意大利人通過從各家麵包房收集大量食物，秘密幫助日本人。
2. 戰事爆發後，意大利以保護意大利人為藉口，於1937年9月分批派遣意大利軍隊前往上海。據可靠數據顯示，上海的意大利公民與意大利士兵的比例為一比七。這些部隊的維持費用由日本支付；同時，意大利人承諾允許日軍通過其在西區的地段以攻擊中國軍隊。

page_data.en:
(2)

Pages 106 - 202

Iguchi, a labourer of Japan, noticed that when
anybody walked a little slower, the Japanese soldier behind
him would at once whip him as if were driving beasts.

On the first page of a diary found on a dying
Chinese soldier was written the following item: "I swear to
drive out the man-killing beasts in order to defend my
fatherland", "Fight for emancipation of the whole race",
and "Liberty, equality, happiness, peace and health are
ours; don't let the robbers deprive of them. My heart
began to throb of shame and disgrace. Yes, we human
beings should not kill one another. We should love one
another. Comrades! don't blame us! We Japanese people
are against the war. We never wish to do such brutal
things; we want peace and amity. It is the warlords and
capitalists who are devils and beasts want war. They are
the destroyers of the Japanese race and the enemy of the
Japanese people. Our guns should be directed against
these devils of the human race. We should declare war
against them!"

'Rise up and resist! Aim our guns at our real
enemy! Countrymen, our enemy is not the Chinese but these
man-slaughtering robbers --- warlords and capitalists.
People of China, you should rise and pull down all the
aggressors and emancipate your whole race. Spread your holy
war of resistance. Victory will be yours!' At last he
shouted with clenched fist: "The holy war of resistance."

Countrymen! Let our youthful blood boil up and
shatter the dream of a man-slaughtering country. Do not
mind the violent cannon fires, the furious bombings, or the
poisonous gas. Use our blood and flesh to extinguish the
fire. Rise and stand on the same front and rush forward.

日本劳工井口（Iguchi）注意到，任何人只要走得稍慢一点，身后的日本士兵就会立刻用鞭子抽打他，仿佛在驱赶牲畜一般。

在一名垂死的中国士兵的日记第一页上，写着以下内容：“我发誓要驱逐这些杀人的野兽，以保卫我的祖国”，“为全民族的解放而战”，以及“自由、平等、幸福、和平与健康属于我们；不要让强盗剥夺它们。我的心因羞耻和耻辱而开始剧烈跳动。是的，我们人类不应自相残杀。我们应该彼此相爱。同志们！不要责怪我们！我们日本人民反对战争。我们绝不愿做如此残暴之事；我们要和平与友好。是那些军阀和资本家，这些魔鬼和野兽，想要战争。他们是日本民族的毁灭者，是日本人民的敌人。我们的枪口应该对准这些人面兽心的魔鬼。我们应该向他们宣战！”

‘起来反抗！把我们的枪口对准我们真正的敌人！同胞们，我们的敌人不是中国人，而是这些屠杀人民的强盗——军阀和资本家。中国人民，你们应该起来推翻所有侵略者，解放你们的整个民族。展开你们神圣的抗战。胜利将属于你们！’最后他握紧拳头高呼：“神圣的抗战。”

同胞们！让我们年轻的血液沸腾起来，粉碎这个杀人国家的梦想。不要在意猛烈的炮火、疯狂的轰炸或毒气。用我们的血肉去扑灭战火。站起来，站在同一战线上，向前冲锋。

Subject Seizure of anti-Japanese books entitled "Duty of Young Men"
and "Articles on Collective Life"
Made by and Forwarded by D. S. McKeown.

On the afternoon of February 28, C.D.C. 230
Chang Yeh reported that copies of two anti-Japanese
books entitled "Duty of Young Men" (青年的任務) and
"Articles on Collective Life" (論集體生活) were on sale
at the Hwa Tung Bookstore (華通書局), 331 Foochow Road.
Copies of these books had been seized on January 6 and
February 11 from various bookstores in the Settlement.
The facts were reported to the D. C. (Special Branch)
through C.D.I. Ross who instructed that the books should
be seized and brought to the office of the Special
Branch. The shop was visited and five copies of each
book were found. Upon enquiring the name of the
bookstore owner, the assistants stated that it was a
Japanese named Nakamura who lived in Hongkew District
and who had recently taken over the shop from the
former Chinese owner. The shop assistants stated
that they had communicated by telephone with the "News
Digest" (譯報), publishers of the books, and had
been told that it was in order to sell them. During
the course of conversation, the assistants stated that
the Japanese owner had seen the books and permitted them
to be sold.

It is learned that the former owner of the
shop named Chen Chun (陳群) was at one time
President of the Military Court at Lunghwa, and is at
present Minister of the Interior of the "Reformed
Government" at Nanking.

2月28日下午，巡长230号张叶（Chang Yeh，音译）报告称，福州路331号华通书店（Hwa Tung Bookstore）正在出售两本反日书籍，书名为《青年的任务》和《论集体生活》。这些书的副本曾于1月6日和2月11日从租界内的多家书店查扣。此事已通过副督察罗斯（Ross）报告给特别处副总监，后者指示查扣这些书籍并带回特别处办公室。经走访该店，发现每种书各有五本。当询问书店老板姓名时，店员称老板是一名住在虹口区、最近从前任中国老板手中接管店铺的日本人中村。店员表示，他们已通过电话与书籍出版方《译报》（News Digest）联系，并被告知出售这些书籍是合规的。在谈话过程中，店员表示日本老板已看过这些书籍并允许出售。

据悉，该店前店主陈群（Chen Chun）曾任龙华军事法庭庭长，现任南京“维新政府”内政部长。
